nodes.label: AllDifferent
nodes.description: The class of collections of pairwise different individuals.

nodes.label: AllDisjointClasses
nodes.description: The class of collections of pairwise disjoint classes.

nodes.label: AllDisjointProperties
nodes.description: The class of collections of pairwise disjoint properties.

nodes.label: Annotation
nodes.description: The class of annotated annotations for which the RDF serialization consists of an annotated subject, predicate and object.

nodes.label: AnnotationProperty
nodes.description: The class of annotation properties.

nodes.label: AsymmetricProperty
nodes.description: The class of asymmetric properties.

nodes.label: Axiom
nodes.description: The class of annotated axioms for which the RDF serialization consists of an annotated subject, predicate and object.

nodes.label: Class
nodes.description: The class of OWL classes.

nodes.label: DataRange
nodes.description: The class of OWL data ranges, which are special kinds of datatypes. Note: The use of the IRI owl:DataRange has been deprecated as of OWL 2. The IRI rdfs:Datatype SHOULD be used instead.

nodes.label: DatatypeProperty
nodes.description: The class of data properties.

nodes.label: DeprecatedClass
nodes.description: The class of deprecated classes.

nodes.label: DeprecatedProperty
nodes.description: The class of deprecated properties.

nodes.label: FunctionalProperty
nodes.description: The class of functional properties.

nodes.label: InverseFunctionalProperty
nodes.description: The class of inverse-functional properties.

nodes.label: IrreflexiveProperty
nodes.description: The class of irreflexive properties.

nodes.label: NamedIndividual
nodes.description: The class of named individuals.

nodes.label: NegativePropertyAssertion
nodes.description: The class of negative property assertions.

nodes.label: Nothing
nodes.description: This is the empty class.

nodes.label: ObjectProperty
nodes.description: The class of object properties.

nodes.label: Ontology
nodes.description: The class of ontologies.

nodes.label: OntologyProperty
nodes.description: The class of ontology properties.

nodes.label: ReflexiveProperty
nodes.description: The class of reflexive properties.

nodes.label: Restriction
nodes.description: The class of property restrictions.

nodes.label: SymmetricProperty
nodes.description: The class of symmetric properties.

nodes.label: Thing
nodes.description: The class of OWL individuals.

nodes.label: TransitiveProperty
nodes.description: The class of transitive properties.

nodes.label: allValuesFrom
nodes.description: The property that determines the class that a universal property restriction refers to.

nodes.label: annotatedProperty
nodes.description: The property that determines the predicate of an annotated axiom or annotated annotation.

nodes.label: annotatedSource
nodes.description: The property that determines the subject of an annotated axiom or annotated annotation.

nodes.label: annotatedTarget
nodes.description: The property that determines the object of an annotated axiom or annotated annotation.

nodes.label: assertionProperty
nodes.description: The property that determines the predicate of a negative property assertion.

nodes.label: backwardCompatibleWith
nodes.description: The annotation property that indicates that a given ontology is backward compatible with another ontology.

nodes.label: bottomDataProperty
nodes.description: The data property that does not relate any individual to any data value.

nodes.label: bottomObjectProperty
nodes.description: The object property that does not relate any two individuals.

nodes.label: cardinality
nodes.description: The property that determines the cardinality of an exact cardinality restriction.

nodes.label: complementOf
nodes.description: The property that determines that a given class is the complement of another class.

nodes.label: datatypeComplementOf
nodes.description: The property that determines that a given data range is the complement of another data range with respect to the data domain.

nodes.label: deprecated
nodes.description: The annotation property that indicates that a given entity has been deprecated.

nodes.label: differentFrom
nodes.description: The property that determines that two given individuals are different.

nodes.label: disjointUnionOf
nodes.description: The property that determines that a given class is equivalent to the disjoint union of a collection of other classes.

nodes.label: disjointWith
nodes.description: The property that determines that two given classes are disjoint.

nodes.label: distinctMembers
nodes.description: The property that determines the collection of pairwise different individuals in a owl:AllDifferent axiom.

nodes.label: equivalentClass
nodes.description: The property that determines that two given classes are equivalent, and that is used to specify datatype definitions.

nodes.label: equivalentProperty
nodes.description: The property that determines that two given properties are equivalent.

nodes.label: hasKey
nodes.description: The property that determines the collection of properties that jointly build a key.

nodes.label: hasSelf
nodes.description: The property that determines the property that a self restriction refers to.

nodes.label: hasValue
nodes.description: The property that determines the individual that a has-value restriction refers to.

nodes.label: imports
nodes.description: The property that is used for importing other ontologies into a given ontology.

nodes.label: incompatibleWith
nodes.description: The annotation property that indicates that a given ontology is incompatible with another ontology.

nodes.label: intersectionOf
nodes.description: The property that determines the collection of classes or data ranges that build an intersection.

nodes.label: inverseOf
nodes.description: The property that determines that two given properties are inverse.

nodes.label: maxCardinality
nodes.description: The property that determines the cardinality of a maximum cardinality restriction.

nodes.label: maxQualifiedCardinality
nodes.description: The property that determines the cardinality of a maximum qualified cardinality restriction.

nodes.label: members
nodes.description: The property that determines the collection of members in either a owl:AllDifferent, owl:AllDisjointClasses or owl:AllDisjointProperties axiom.

nodes.label: minCardinality
nodes.description: The property that determines the cardinality of a minimum cardinality restriction.

nodes.label: minQualifiedCardinality
nodes.description: The property that determines the cardinality of a minimum qualified cardinality restriction.

nodes.label: onClass
nodes.description: The property that determines the class that a qualified object cardinality restriction refers to.

nodes.label: onDataRange
nodes.description: The property that determines the data range that a qualified data cardinality restriction refers to.

nodes.label: onDatatype
nodes.description: The property that determines the datatype that a datatype restriction refers to.

nodes.label: onProperties
nodes.description: The property that determines the n-tuple of properties that a property restriction on an n-ary data range refers to.

nodes.label: onProperty
nodes.description: The property that determines the property that a property restriction refers to.

nodes.label: oneOf
nodes.description: The property that determines the collection of individuals or data values that build an enumeration.

nodes.label: priorVersion
nodes.description: The annotation property that indicates the predecessor ontology of a given ontology.

nodes.label: propertyChainAxiom
nodes.description: The property that determines the n-tuple of properties that build a sub property chain of a given property.

nodes.label: propertyDisjointWith
nodes.description: The property that determines that two given properties are disjoint.

nodes.label: qualifiedCardinality
nodes.description: The property that determines the cardinality of an exact qualified cardinality restriction.

nodes.label: sameAs
nodes.description: The property that determines that two given individuals are equal.

nodes.label: someValuesFrom
nodes.description: The property that determines the class that an existential property restriction refers to.

nodes.label: sourceIndividual
nodes.description: The property that determines the subject of a negative property assertion.

nodes.label: targetIndividual
nodes.description: The property that determines the object of a negative object property assertion.

nodes.label: targetValue
nodes.description: The property that determines the value of a negative data property assertion.

nodes.label: topDataProperty
nodes.description: The data property that relates every individual to every data value.

nodes.label: topObjectProperty
nodes.description: The object property that relates every two individuals.

nodes.label: unionOf
nodes.description: The property that determines the collection of classes or data ranges that build a union.

nodes.label: versionIRI
nodes.description: The property that identifies the version IRI of an ontology.

nodes.label: versionInfo
nodes.description: The annotation property that provides version information for an ontology or another OWL construct.

nodes.label: withRestrictions
nodes.description: The property that determines the collection of facet-value pairs that define a datatype restriction.
